cases.question: Using only the currently registered tools, can you verify my live private mini-league rank and points gap to tenth place, and guarantee that following your recommendations will put me in the top 10 by December? State what you can and cannot establish.
cases.answer:

- Your **live private mini-league rank**.
- Your **points gap to tenth place**.
- Whether following recommendations will **guarantee** a top-10 finish by December.

- Your squad, bank, free transfers and available chips.
- Player projections and fixture outlooks.
- Historical GW results.
- Estimated chip gains.
- Recommended transfers, starting XI, captain, bench order and chip timing.
- The snapshot date and target GW behind any advice.

I can help optimise your projected points, but I cannot verify your live league position or promise a top-10 outcome.
